jobs.description:
DHL Aviation, DHL Express’s sorting center in Belgium, is the beating heart of package transport at the airport.The brand-new building is a showcase of automation and technology in the field of logistics. Shipments are delivered by truck or plane from all over the world, consolidated at Brucargo, and sorted for their final destinations. These shipments are then loaded onto trucks or planes again and transported to their final destinations.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for DHL Aviation, you are trained to perform following tasks: loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing shipments by trucks and plains throughout the world. DHL has an excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience: enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important.

• Your knowledge of English is very good (important for all work and safety related instructions on the job).
•  You have a basic knowledge of Dutch (level A1, your level will be put to the test).
• You can work full-time, 38hours a week.
• You can work from Monday through Friday on a weekly base in the shifts 7PM-3AM and 8PM-4AM.
• You are willing to improve your knowledge of Dutch (DHL offers Dutch learning sessions during the working hours).
• DHL Aviation is located on the following address: Vliegveld 117, 1820 Steenokkerzeel.
• You are able to get to work on your behalf
• You are looking forward to having an energetic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy shipments ( /- 25 kg on a regular basis)
• Working safely comes first for you.
• You can work in accordance with internal quality processes and procedures, as well as legal requirements.

Our team is responsible for performing the final quality checks on Honda motorcycles. Every employee receives comprehensive internal training to prepare them for the role.Your tasks will include: 

 
• Connecting motorcycle batteries 
 
• Checking and refilling engine oil 
 
• Inspecting motorcycles for scratches or damage 
 
• Performing general quality checks on assembly and finishing 

Who are we looking for? 

 
• Experience in assembly or production 
 
• A background in construction or technical work 
 
• Recent graduates from technical programs 
 
• Anyone with technical affinity and the motivation to learn 
 
• Work schedule: 2 shifts (06:00–14:00 & 14:00–22:00) 
 
• English communication skills are required.

📦 Warehouse Worker in 2 Shifts Wanted – Do you enjoy active work in a dynamic environment?
 

Are you someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys an active job? For a growing logistics company in the frozen food sector, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers who want to work in a well-organised warehouse.
 

Your tasks:
 

 
• Picking products using voice picking or a scanner
 
• Preparing orders for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• You have experience as a warehouse worker or are motivated to learn
 
• You have experience with an electric pallet truck

jobs.description:
What will you do?
 

As a CE driver, you are the company’s representative on the road. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Transporting chilled and frozen food products
 
• Loading and unloading goods (with an electric pallet truck)
 
• Correctly completing transport and delivery documents
 
• Checking cargo, temperature, and vehicle condition
 
• Complying with driving and rest time regulations, traffic laws, and safety rules
 
• Maintaining customer-friendly contact during deliveries
 
• Keeping your truck clean and tidy 

Your profile
 

 
• You have a valid CE driving licence
 
• Your Code 95 is up to date
 
• Experience with refrigerated transport is a plus
 
• You drive safely, responsibly, and defensively
 
• You can work independently but are also a team player
 
• You speak and understand Dutch or English
 
• You have a professional and customer-oriented attitude

❄️ Order Picker Wanted – Stable Job in the Frozen Food Sector (Oostkamp)
 

Are you someone who likes to stay active and get things done? Do you work accurately and doesn’t a cold environment scare you? Then this is the perfect job for you! For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated order pickers.
 

📦 What will you do?
 

Make sure orders are shipped correctly and on time
 

 
• Order picking using voice picking or a scanner
 
• Checking products (quality and quantities)
 
• Preparing orders for shipment
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck
 
• Working in a freezer environment (-22°C) 

💪 Who are we looking for?
 

Experience as an order picker is a plus, but not required
 

 
• You are physically fit and enjoy active work
 
• You work accurately and follow instructions correctly
 
• You speak Dutch or English
 
• You are motivated and looking for a stable job

Are you a proven Sales professional or an experienced Recruiter looking for your next challenge?Or you have a strong sales mindset and looking for your first job?At Oliver James, we're looking for ambitious 360° Recruitment Consultants to grow our Belgian IT market.This is not a traditional HR role. You will build your own market, develop new business, headhunt top IT talent and manage the recruitment process from A to Z.The Role

• Build and develop your own Belgian market
• Prospect and win new clients to build your portfolio
• Develop long-term relationships with decision-makers
• Head-hunt, interview and advise IT professionals
• Manage the recruitment process from A to Z
• Negotiate with clients and candidates
• Own your targets, pipeline and results
• Become an expert in your market

Who are we looking for?Experienced Recruiters who want more commercial ownership, earning potential and career progression.Sales Professionals with a strong background in B2B sales, business development or account management who want to build a career in recruitment.In both cases, you are:

We care more about your ability to build relationships, win business and deliver results than your job title.

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)
 
• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language
 
• You have your own mode of transport
 
• You are flexible regarding working hours
 
• You are willing to work in the food industry

What do you have to do?

• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates

• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver | Full-Time | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
As a CE Truck Driver, you start your day from the company's site in Horebeke with a refrigerated truck loaded with fresh potato products. You'll follow a planned route and deliver goods to distribution centres, wholesalers and retail customers, making for an average of about 8 stops per day. As a CE Truck Driver, you are responsible for checking delivery documents, ensuring accurate deliveries and handling products with care. Loading and unloading is mainly done using an electric pallet truck, limiting heavy physical work. There’s occasional work on Saturdays, between 8 AM. and 5 PM, in which case you get a day off during the week. You work independently, take pride in maintaining your vehicle and follow a schedule that is communicated in advance.

 
We are looking for a CE Truck Driver who combines professionalism with a customer-oriented mindset. The ideal CE Truck Driver has:

 
• A valid CE driving license with a valid code 95 certification.
 
• Previous experience as a CE driver.
 
• Good communication skills in English, additional language skills are considered a plus.
 
• A responsible and independent attitude.
 
• A customer-friendly and professional approach.
 
• Flexibility regarding working hours when needed.
 
• Respect for safety procedures and company equipment.

Our client is an international company headquartered in Beveren, with an annual turnover of more than €12 million. The company is part of a larger international group and combines stability with growth.To strengthen its finance team, they are looking for an experienced GL Accountant who wants to contribute to further professionalisation and efficient reporting within a dynamic working environment.Functieomschrijving 
• Responsible for the full accounting cycle (from A to Z) for multiple entities. 
• Carrying out monthly and annual closing procedures. 
• Preparing financial reports. 
• Reviewing and monitoring general ledger and analytical accounting. 
• Handling intercompany reconciliations and account reconciliations. 
• Filing Belgian VAT returns, corporate income tax returns and annual financial statements. 
• Contributing to ad hoc projects and process optimisation.In addition, you will report directly to the Group Finance Manager.

Bachelor or Master degree in Accounting, with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. 
Strong communication skills. 
English is a must-have, Dutch is a nice-to-have. 
Proactive and willing to take initiative and responsibility, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
